Our lab results platform is getting more complex — we now have three downstream workers (billing, EHR sync, and alert dispatcher) all consuming lab result events from a central hub. The team has been arguing about whether we need 'exactly-once' guarantees, and we've had incidents where the billing worker charged patients twice and the alert dispatcher missed a critical result during a deploy.

I need you to produce a comprehensive messaging design document called `lab_results_messaging_design.md` that the engineering team can use as the authoritative reference going forward. The document should cover everything from how we decide what delivery guarantees each worker needs, to how we structure our messages, handle failures, and monitor health in production. Make sure it's complete enough that a new engineer could implement the system from it — including what to do when things go wrong.
